purpose: Close the two open F10 evidence items: PAUSED/EOS live DSD-to-PCM DSP convergence and physical T03/T04 Managed <-> DSD-to-PCM handover.

production_changes.change: Track the live DSD-to-PCM pipeline PAUSED state and fail closed (DSP_PAUSED_REQUIRES_RESUME) for DSP install/removal while paused; resume restores the negotiated pipeline before processing changes.
production_changes.reason: A physical DSP reconfiguration must never autoplay a paused source or deadlock the host on a paused filter teardown.

facts.paused_dsp_install: typed failure DSP_PAUSED_REQUIRES_RESUME; previous graph remains installed; PlaybackStatus stays PAUSED; no autoplay
facts.paused_dsp_removal: typed failure DSP_PAUSED_REQUIRES_RESUME; previous graph remains installed; PlaybackStatus stays PAUSED; no autoplay
facts.resume: after resume the processing transaction completes; EFFECTIVE graph revision 3 with negotiated caps
facts.eos: output-family event dsd_pcm/UNAVAILABLE detail=eos; processing effective_state=unavailable; no second accepted media; explicit stop reaches IDLE

paused_eos.limitation: DSP changes requested while PAUSED are refused until resume; they are not silently applied to a quiescent pipeline.

physical_handover.command: env -u MICHI_GST_LAB_SINK MICHI_PHYSICAL_DAC_TESTS=1 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python -m pytest tests/audio_phase2/test_f10_s17_physical_managed_dsd.py -q

device.name: SMSL USB AUDIO
device.reason_for_plughw: The SMSL exposes S32_LE at the hw layer and does not expose F32LE; the DSD-to-PCM terminal contract remains F32LE and ALSA performs the final container conversion through plughw.

t03.release_receipt: confirmed, terminal_state=RELEASED, provenance=SUPERVISED_HOST, exact predecessor plan/execution, device=plughw:CARD=AUDIO,DEV=0, target_family=dsd_pcm
t03.playback: real alsasink through plughw; PLAYING; explicit STOP reaches IDLE

t04.release_receipt: confirmed, terminal_state=RELEASED, provenance=SUPERVISED_HOST, exact predecessor plan/execution, device=plughw:CARD=AUDIO,DEV=0, target_family=managed
t04.playback: real alsasink through plughw; PLAYING; explicit STOP reaches IDLE

caveats.registry_binding: The test injects a physical plughw locator into the productive fake-topology device; the host chain, ALSA sink and DAC are real.
caveats.f14: F14 remains NOT_RUN as a formal independent phase.

remaining_non_blocking: Hardware-native F32LE is unavailable on the SMSL; physical DSD-to-PCM uses ALSA plughw.
F14 physical qualification remains a separate NOT_RUN phase.
